name: 2.5 DIMENSIONAL SEDUCTION: Angels on Stage!
detailed_description:
The anime "2.5 Dimensional Seduction" debuts its first game!
Get your cameras ready for the cosplay battle RPG "2.5 Dimensional Seduction: Angels on Stage!"

STORY

"2.5 Dimensional Seduction" follows Masamune Okumura, a high schooler in love with the fictional character Liliel, and Ririsa Amano, a new student who dreams of becoming the said character.



After Ririsa asks Okumura to help her achieve her dream, he's roped into becoming the cameraman for her Liliel cosplays! As the two work together, they experience the fires of passion within cosplayers and learn from their trials and tribulations. The lines between reality (3D) and fiction (2D) blur in this hot-blooded cosplay drama!

CHARACTERS

■ Masamune Okumura (VA: Junya Enoki)
A second-year high schooler and leader of the Manga Club, he is a proud otaku. He has long loved the fictional character Liliel and calls her his "waifu." After Ririsa joins the Manga Club, he becomes her cosplay cameraman.

■ Ririsa Amano (VA: Kaori Maeda)
A freshman otaku obsessed with manga and anime. She's especially into the outfits girls wear in fiction. After attending her first event in junior high, she decided to express her love for Liliel through cosplay. Ririsa's cosplay is so top-level it astounded the Liliel-maniac Okumura.

■ Mikari Tachibana (VA: Akari Kitō)
Ririsa's classmate and ultra-popular fashion model. She's adoringly called "Mikarin" by her fans. As a childhood friend of Okumura, she's been in love with him for 10 years. But unfortunately, due to his infatuation with 2D, her feelings are unnoticed.

■ Mayuri Hanyuu (VA: M.A.O)
The new Home Economics teacher at Okumura's high school. She is popular among the students for being drop-dead gorgeous and easy to talk to. Her identity back in college is "Mayura," one of the Four Heavenly Queens of Cosplay.

GAME FEATURES

- Strike a pose in this fresh, new cosplay battle!
Charm your rival cosplayers and audience with stunning poses! Impress your way to victory!
Your options range from familiar poses, to brand new ones! There're even group shoots...!
And don't miss out on special poses with over-the-top effects!

- Raise a character's bond level and learn new things about them!
Spend time with your favorite character and deepen your relationship!

- Relive the world of "2.5 Dimensional Seduction" in-game!
Follow the story of Okumura and Ririsa through top-quality 3D Graphics, animated cutscenes, and a main story fully voiced by the Japanese cast!

- Experience the never-before-seen "2.5 Dimensional Emotion (Mayuri)"!
From her love for Lustalotte, to how she became a cosplayer, there's more to learn about Mayuri.
Read her origin story in this game-exclusive spin-off!

- Live the otaku life through club activities!
AFK to obtain materials that level up your beautiful cosplayers to then tackle quests and challenges!

- Enjoy "Angels on Stage" characters and the extravagant voice cast!
Masamune Okumura (VA: Junya Enoki)
Ririsa Amano (VA: Kaori Maeda)
Mikari Tachibana (VA: Akari Kitō)
Nonoa (VA: Sayumi Suzushiro)
Aria Kisaki (VA: Sayumi Watabe)
Nagomi (VA: Aya Yamane)
Mayuri Hanyuu (VA: M.A.O)
Magino (VA: Yuka Nukui)
Ogino (VA: Tomokazu Sugita)
and more!!
